messages:
alex: hey all, first-week onboarding question — kicked off the `ingest-service` Buildkite pipeline and the checkout step immediately failed with 403. log says: "fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood/ingest-service.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403". i'm in the org and accepted invites, what's the usual missing piece?

toni: welcome alex :wave: do you see any GH App consent prompts in the org? also, did you add an SSH key to your account? sometimes pipeline tries HTTPS and fails if the GH App installation hasn't been granted repo access.

alex: i don't see any GH App prompts. haven't added SSH key yet, been using web UI so far. the remote on my fork is `git@github.com:alex/ingest-service.git` locally. buildkite shows https remote though.

toni: ok — two things: 1) org GitHub App (ci-bots) must be installed on the repo or your account must be in the `ci-runners` team so the installation covers you. 2) pipelines run on Buildkite agents that may use the GH App to clone; if the app isn't installed, you'll hit 403 even if your user is a member. i'll check the app install and your team membership.

infra-bot: infra:ticket created #2410 "Grant alex access to ci-runners and verify ci-bots app on ingest-service" (assignee: toni)

toni: invited you to `ci-runners` and re-requested ci-bots installation on the repo. once you accept the team invite, add an SSH key (`cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub`) to github.com/settings/keys and push a tiny commit to trigger a build.

alex: accepted invite and added SSH key. re-triggered pipeline from the UI.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite: pipeline `ingest-service/push` #12 failed on job `checkout` 1exit code 128 — fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com': No such device or address

toni: hmm that log still shows the agent tried HTTPS. check the repo config in the pipeline step: we have a checkout hook that sometimes overrides remotes to HTTPS for CI tokens. i'll update the job to prefer SSH for private repos.

toni: updated pipeline hook and re-triggered. also confirmed ci-bots app install is pending org consent, infra re-requested it.

alex: build #13 is running — looks like it got past checkout this time. :tada:

buildkite-bot: Buildkite: pipeline `ingest-service/push` #13 succeeded on job `checkout` 1duration 38s

toni: great — root causes were: missing SSH key + pipeline hook forcing HTTPS + ci-bots app not installed for repo. i'll add a short onboarding note: "accept org GH App, join ci-runners, add SSH key, verify pipeline checkout method".
alex: thanks everyone, saved my morning. will file a tiny docs PR with the checklist.
